description: You are designing an office space with two types of desks: long desks and short desks. You can spend at most $2000. Long desks cost $300, take up 10 square feet of space, and seat 6 employees. Short desks cost $100, take up 4 square feet of space, and seat 2 employees. The office can have at most 200 square feet of desks. How many of each desk should you buy in order to maximize the seating availability?

Space.definition: Space occupied by each desk type

Seats.definition: Seating capacity of each desk type

objective.description: "The goal is to maximize the total seating capacity (total number of employees that can be seated) provided by the desks purchased"

constraints.description: The total cost of all desks purchased should not exceed the maximum budget
The total space occupied by all desks should not exceed the maximum available office space
The number of desks purchased for each type must be nonnegative integers

NumDesks.definition: Number of desks purchased for each desk type
